title: STATION DC: Fireside chat with NPR's Ari Shapiro on the Incorruptible launch tour
summary: STATION DC hosts Eric in conversation with NPR's Ari Shapiro — a fireside chat for DC founders, operators, and policymakers, followed by a happy hour and book signing at STATION's Union Market space.
blockquote: STATION DC is proud to host an evening with Eric Ries to celebrate the release of his new book, Incorruptible — an unflinching look at how incentives, systems, and human behavior shape outcomes in ways we don't always see, but feel every day.
blockquote_source: STATION DC event listing on Luma
attribution_title: DC's hub for founders, operators, and policymakers building at the intersection of tech and government
